stratagems.name: Waaagh!
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in your unit and re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on an unmodified Hit roll of 6, score 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: More Dakka!
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army with 10 or more models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. In addition, unmodified Hit rolls of 6 score 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Ere We Go
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit. In addition, your unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.
